name: Fish-raft village
kicker: Fish-farm rafts at the river junction
summary: Fish-farm rafts at the river junction: take a boat among the cages and see the farms on the water. The community is about 50 years old and raises catfish and snapper. A 2024 project painted the rafts in six colors. Printed counts are 165, more than 160, and 161. Ask the fare at the boat before you board.
getThere: By boat from the town bank, or by road to Cồn Tiên bridge.
bestMonths: August to November for high water
heroCaption: A fish-farm raft house on the Hậu at Châu Đốc

notice.title: Ask the fare before you board
notice.body: No pier tariff is posted. These are fish farms at the Châu Đốc river junction, beside Cồn Tiên bridge. Cái Răng, in Can Tho, is a produce market on a different river.

body: Go by boat among raft houses that raise fish. The community is about 50 years old and sells catfish and snapper. In early 2024 the project Làng bè Sắc Màu painted 165 rafts in six color blocks. Another report counts more than 160 cages, and also 161, over more than 1 km, in red, yellow, orange, green, blue, and purple. Lights show after dark. Both counts stay.

The rafts sit on the Châu Đốc river at the former town of Đa Phước, beside the old city, next to Cồn Tiên bridge. You can combine them with Châu Phong and Đa Phước. High water from August to November is the window named for the floating villages.
Ask the price before you board.

figures.caption: Boats tied alongside the raft houses on the Châu Đốc river
figures.alt: A man standing on a fish-farm raft with wooden boats alongside at Chau Doc

gettingThere: Take a boat from the town bank, or the road to Cồn Tiên bridge. Minutes were not printed. The province does not print a minute count for combining the rafts with the Cham villages either.

legs.heading: From the Châu Đốc riverbank
legs.body: By boat. Ask the price at the landing. Minutes are check on arrival.

legs.heading: From Cồn Tiên bridge
legs.body: By road to the bridge named beside the rafts. Minutes are check on arrival.

closed: No closing hour was published. Lights after dark are described. A last boat is check on arrival.
admissionNote: No pier tariff was opened. Check on arrival. Leave out any fare that appeared only in an interview.
